integrity: The polynomial identities were independently reproduced by standalone exact code, while the geometric degree, characteristic-two inseparability and anticanonical-net arguments are supplied as proofs. No outside validation or unique historical priority is claimed.
limitations: Only Cayley's displayed four-node cubic over algebraically closed characteristic two; the first-stage projection is a rational map and the second-stage blowup morphism may contract curves. Independent priority verification and scientific audit are not performed.
title: Fano-plane factorization of the characteristic-two Gauss map of Cayley's nodal cubic
